$comment: Sprint 1 hardening - rate-limit rules. Cloudflare free tier allows ONE rule per phase on http_ratelimit, so we combine the stripe-webhook (100/hour) and AI endpoints (60/min) into a single rule that picks the tighter window per path. Upgrade to Business plan or WAF Advanced to split these into two rules.

rules.description: P-A-05+P-A-06: Free-tier rate-limit guard for /api/public/payments/webhook and /api/public/ai/*. Free tier allows only period=10s; rule uses 30 req/10s for both paths. Upgrade to Business plan or WAF Advanced to use 60/min (AI) and 100/h (webhook).
